expectations.text: Configures the module via the nats: key in nuxt.config
expectations.evidence: Sidesteps the module; hand-rolls a raw @nats-io/nats client in server/utils/nats.ts + a startup plugin
Uses runtimeConfig + env with jwtAuthenticator; keeps secrets out of the public block

expectations.text: Publishes with jsPublish and sets msgId for dedup
expectations.evidence: Uses raw js.publish (not the module's jsPublish); does set msgID

expectations.text: NatsEvents interface augmentation for typed subjects
expectations.evidence: Uses a shared interface + JSONCodec<OrderCreated>() (legacy codec, removed in v3) instead of NatsEvents

expectations.text: Passes all cluster nodes and/or provision:'never'
expectations.evidence: Passes all three node URLs to the servers array
